description: Withdraw your submitted timesheet for a given month back to Draft (un-submit), reopening entries for editing. Only valid while the period is Submitted — after approval ask a manager to reopen it. Supply year and month (1-12).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

year.description: Calendar year of the month to recall (e.g. 2026).

name: recall_timesheet
